segments.text: Is this the method God uses to reconcile men to himself? O then examine your selves whether yet the preaching of the Gospel hath reconciled you to God. It's too manifest that many among us are in the state of enmity unto this day: we may say with the Prophet Isaiah, 53. 1. Who hath believed our report? and to whom is the arm of the Lord revealed? We offer you peace upon Gospel terms and Articles, but our peace returns to us again: enemies you were to God, and enemies you still continue. The Evidence is undeniable; for
